description: Open a staged write when a document will not fit in one write_doc argument. The stage is not a document and does not change the current revision. Send each part with write_doc_append, then write_doc_commit. A record (HANDOFF.md and any id in EMET_RECORD_DOCS) still needs supersedes and reason; commit writes one whole revision through write_doc. Limits: 16000 characters per part, 128 parts, 2000000 characters total, 30 minutes from begin, 4 open stages per writer. Same source, session, and writer stamp as write_doc.

exchange.description: The exchange (turn) this write belongs to, counting from 1. A write for exchange n while exchange n-1 was never appended is refused by the session graph until n-1 is appended.

reason.description: Required on a record revision (at least 10 characters). Stored on the stage and passed to write_doc at commit.

session_id.description: Your transcript session id from emet_session_open. The session graph reads this session's state before the write and returns `session_graph.next` - the next step. A governed write with no session is refused (open one with emet_session_open and load_id).

source.description: Source tag - which host produced this write. One name on every write since 2026-09-27.

supersedes.description: Required when staging a new revision of a RECORD: the version currently in force. Stored on the stage and passed to write_doc at commit.

updated_by.description: Alias of `source` (the older name, kept one release). Prefer `source`.

name: write_doc_begin
